title.value: Learning Conditional Policies for Crystal Design Using Offline Reinforcement Learning

extractions.description: The paper formulates crystal structure composition design as a sequential decision-making problem and trains conditional policies with conservative Q-learning (CQL) on offline trajectories built from Materials Project MP-20 crystals, with rewards derived from DFT (Quantum Espresso) total energy and band gap. Generated crystals are evaluated with DFT and compared against random policy, behavioral cloning, and unconditioned CQL baselines.

type.quote: Our experiments show that our conditioned policies achieve more targeted crystal structure designs
type.justification: The paper trains models and reports experimental metrics.
